Just outside Malmö you find a leading paint company with a focus on innovation and sustainability. One of the Nordic region's largest sites where we develop, manufacture, market and sell paint for indoor and outdoor environments for consumers, customers and industry. The business mainly consists of two companies. Akzo Nobel Industrial Coatings, a leader in the sale and manufacture of paints and coatings for industrial surface treatment for wood products such as windows, doors, floors, and furniture. Some of the customers are IKEA, Montana, Inwido and Tarkett. The other company Akzo Nobel Decorative Coatings develops, manufactures, distributes, and sells paints, varnishes, putty and wood protection products to professional painters and consumers. The portfolio includes the well-known brands Nordsjö, Sadolin and Cuprinol. 
 
 
Are you driven by creating smarter, more sustainable industrial operations? Join us on a two-year fixed-term contract in a key role where you will lead energy improvement initiatives, influence site performance and turn ambitious sustainability goals into measurable business results.
 
 
What can AkzoNobel offer you?
At AkzoNobel you are met by a warm and welcoming atmosphere. We work together with a focus on innovation and sustainability, to be the leader in our industry. Diversity enriches our workplaces, and we work actively together with our employees to make them thrive and develop. We work strategically to become a better employer. This has resulted in that we have been appointed one of Sweden's Career Company 2026. We offer you an international working environment where you take on rewarding and challenging tasks that broaden your horizon and develop you in your role. You will work with competent and like-minded colleagues who share your attitude and enthusiasm. Welcome!
 
 
About the role 
As Projects Manager – Energy, you will play a central role in driving the energy agenda at our Malmö site forward. Working across production areas, buildings and utilities, you will identify opportunities, lead improvement initiatives and ensure that energy-saving projects are successfully implemented and followed up.
This is a broad and business-critical role where you combine technical expertise with project leadership and stakeholder management. You will collaborate closely with functions such as Engineering, Maintenance, Production, HSE and Procurement, while also acting as an important counterpart towards external contractors and facility management partners.

The position offers a great opportunity to make a visible impact by improving operational efficiency, reducing energy consumption and supporting long-term sustainability targets in a modern industrial environment.
 
Key responsibilities: 
• Lead and execute the Malmö Site Energy Roadmap
• Drive energy efficiency projects from concept to implementation• Identify and prioritize opportunities for energy and cost savings
• Monitor energy performance, KPIs and metering systems
• Develop business cases, project scopes and implementation plans
• Coordinate energy-related activities across the site
• Optimize HVAC, BMS, ventilation and utility performance
• Challenge and coordinate facility management and external contractors
• Support shutdown and non-production energy reduction initiatives
• Follow up, verify and report realized savings and project results
 
This is a full-time position on a two-year fixed-term contract, based in Arlöv, just outside Malmö. You will report to the Project Manager Lead.
 
 
Who are you?
We are looking for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking with hands-on project execution. You are comfortable working in a dynamic industrial environment where collaboration, initiative and continuous improvement are key to success.
 

You have the ability to build strong relationships across different functions and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. At the same time, you are confident in challenging existing ways of working and driving improvements that create long-term value for the business.
 

To succeed in this role, you should have a structured approach, strong problem-solving skills and a genuine interest in energy efficiency and sustainable operations.
 
 
Key qualifications: 
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Energy or another relevant Engineering field
• Experience in industrial energy management and/or energy efficiency projects• Project management experience within industrial or manufacturing environments
• Knowledge of industrial utilities, energy systems and energy monitoring
• Experience working with HVAC/BMS and related optimization activities
• Ability to develop technical and financial business cases
• Strong stakeholder and contractor management skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Swedish and English
 
Meritorious / preferred: 
• Experience with ISO 50001• Previous experience as an Energy Engineer or Industrial Energy Manager
• Experience with energy KPI and metering systems
• Background in CAPEX/OPEX project delivery
• Experience implementing energy-saving initiatives in industrial environments
 
 
Your application 
At AkzoNobel we are very committed to ensuring an inclusive and respectful workplace where all employees can be their best selves. We strive to embrace diversity, tolerance and respect. Our recruitment process plays a major role in this journey as it lays the foundation for a diverse work environment. In our organization, all qualified applicants are treated from an equal perspective regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age or disability.
 
We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.
 
For information about the role and recruitment process, please contact Ami Sandberg, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics, ami.sandberg@akzonobel.com

RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.
RaySearch is expanding its machine learning capabilities and is looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to join our headquarters in Stockholm. This is an office-first role. 
You will help build our model development platform: the systems that take clinical data through curation, training and validation to deployed models. Our deep learning models are used in RayStation, our treatment planning system, at cancer clinics worldwide. The platform you build is how the next generation of these models gets made. 
This is not primarily a model development role. Your focus is the platform, data and infrastructure that let ML engineers develop, validate and deploy models reliably. 
About the job 
You will join RaySearch's Machine Learning department and help build a platform that covers the full model lifecycle, from clinical data coming in to validated models going out. 
The work spans: 
Data curation and management: ingesting, organizing and validating large clinical datasets and medical images, with ETL, databases and storage that keep track of where data came from and how it was used. 
Model training: reproducible training pipelines orchestrated with Flyte, for dose prediction, segmentation, detection, classification and image registration, with monitoring of training runs. 
Validation: automated evaluation and reporting that connects data, method, code and results, including web-based tools for reviewing images, contours, radiotherapy plans and validation outcomes. 
Deployment and ML integration: getting models into production and integrated into our software products, including inference optimization. 
Operations: monitoring training and evaluation runs, keeping services and databases up to date, and troubleshooting when things go wrong. 
The platform is used by multiple teams and projects, so good design matters: well-designed APIs, solid documentation and reliable services. You will own services from design to operation and work closely with ML engineers, software developers, infrastructure teams, medical physicists and product teams.

Your profile 
You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys building systems that help others do their best work. You are pragmatic: you know when a simple solution is enough and when the problem needs a more scalable architecture. You care about reliability, automation and developer experience. You like building platforms that are robust and well-designed enough to serve many different users. 
You don't need to spend your days training neural networks. You do understand how ML development differs from traditional software engineering, and you find problems like reproducibility, data lineage, model versioning, large datasets and GPU workloads interesting. 
Requirements 
M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning or equivalent experience, and at least 5 years of professional software engineering. 
Strong Python skills and experience designing backend services and APIs. 
Solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling, such as PostgreSQL. 
Experience with containers, for example Docker, and with designing, running and troubleshooting production services. 
Good engineering practices: automated testing, code review, CI/CD and observability. 
Experience contributing to architecture decisions in large, shared codebases. 
Excellent spoken and written English. 

Meriting
Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage: 
ML platforms and MLOps tooling, such as MLflow and experiment tracking. 
PyTorch, and model deployment or inference optimization, such as TensorRT. 
Workflow orchestration and ETL. We use Flyte, but experience with Airflow, Prefect, Dagster or similar is just as relevant. 
Kubernetes, cloud platforms and infrastructure as code. 
Designing platforms and APIs used by many teams or users, including access control and security. 
Operating production services with high reliability requirements. 
Web application development. 
Medical imaging (DICOM, RT structures), healthcare technology or other regulated, safety-critical environments. 

Our Culture  
At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.  
Our Offer  
We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.  
Application  
Please apply for the position through the application form below. Selection and interviews will be ongoing. We do not accept applications via e-mail.

TL;DR
We're looking for an exceptional AI Software Engineer to build the AI-powered People systems that help Lovable scale.
As Lovable grows, we're rethinking how work gets done. Rather than relying on traditional HR software, we're building AI-native products that transform hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, identity, compliance, and other core People workflows.
You'll work embedded with our People team, partnering closely with stakeholders to understand problems, design solutions, and ship production-ready software. Many of the products you build won't stop at improving Lovable internally — they have the potential to become capabilities we offer to customers in the future, giving you the opportunity to shape products that start inside Lovable and scale far beyond it.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
Why join now?
Very few engineering roles offer this level of ownership.
You'll help define how AI transforms internal operations. You'll work directly with the People team to identify problems, design solutions, and build products that improve how Lovable operates every day.
As Lovable scales, we're building the operating system the company runs on—function by function, directly in Lovable. The People team is one of the first. You'll help define how AI transforms one of our most important internal functions, and the best ideas will eventually become building blocks for our customers.
What we're looking for
We're looking for a software engineer with strong product instincts and experience building secure software that handles sensitive information.
You'll likely have:
Experience shipping production software that handles sensitive data — HR tech, fintech, identity management, or similar.
Experience working with people data, business systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data infrastructure (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Airflow, Fivetran, SQL, etc.).
Deep familiarity with HR systems and/or ATS platforms (HiBob, Ashby, Workday, Greenhouse, or similar), either as a builder or through close collaboration with People teams.
Experience designing secure systems with role-based access control and data permissioning.
Strong product instincts—you think end-to-end, ask why, and care about building products people actually use.
Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate operational challenges into technical solutions.
Experience building products from scratch and taking them into production.

Bonus points if you have:
Experience at an HR technology company, Work OS platform, or identity provider,
Experience with HRIS, ATS, compensation, workforce planning tools.
Experience building AI-powered products or internal tooling.
Experience working closely with People or Operations teams.

What you'll do
In one sentence:
Build AI-powered People systems that make Lovable run better — and create products that can graduate from internal tools to customer-facing features.
Examples include:
Partner with the People team to identify, scope, and ship AI-powered internal products.
Build integrations with HR systems (HiBob, Ashby, etc.), ATS platforms, and identity providers.
Design secure systems with robust role-based permissions and access controls.
Develop predictive and diagnostic models (workforce trends, hiring capacity, retention risks, compensation dynamics).
Create canonical datasets and source-of-truth models for hiring, headcount, compensation, organizational design, and workforce planning.
Data governance — source-of-truth logic, naming conventions, ownership.
Own products end-to-end—from research and design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.
Translate operational challenges into elegant technical solutions.
Build systems that meet legal and compliance requirements for handling sensitive employee data.
Work closely with other AI Ops Engineers, sharing building blocks, patterns, and learnings across Lovable's functions.
Build AI agents, workflows, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leaders make better decisions.

Our tech stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love.
Languages: TypeScript, Python, Go
AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP, AI Agents
Business Systems: HiBob, Ashby, Okta
Infrastructure: Cloudflare, PostgreSQL, Temporal
We're always looking for better tools and better ways of building software.
About your application
Please submit your application in English — it's our company language.
We review every application carefully and encourage anyone excited by the role to apply, even if your background doesn't perfectly match every bullet point.

At Instabee, we’re bringing together three of the Nordics' most loved delivery brands—Instabox, Porterbuddy, and Budbee—to build the future of European e-commerce delivery. Sweden is our innovation hub: the home market where we test bold ideas, build scalable models, and set the standard for the rest of Europe.
We are growing fast, and with scale comes complexity. We’re looking for a curious, collaborative, and analytical Market Intelligence Manager to step in, own our market knowledge, and help shape our strategic growth. Beyond your technical expertise, we are looking for someone with the ambition and potential to develop alongside Instabee and take on broader responsibilities over time.
The Role
As our Market Intelligence Manager, you will serve as the commercial compass for our Swedish business. You’ll blend sharp analytical thinking with creative problem-solving—combining "detective work" and technical tools to uncover market opportunities, track competitor dynamics, and turn raw data into strategic decisions.
You won't just generate reports; you’ll empower teams, partner directly with Key Account Managers, and experiment with modern tech (like AI agents and custom web scraping) to automate routine tracking and focus on high-impact insights.
Key Responsibilities:

Landscape & Competitor Intelligence: Map the evolving e-commerce ecosystem, analyze market share, perform win/loss analyses, and keep our teams informed on regional and competitor strategies (products, pricing, positioning, and financial moves).

Market Modeling & Data Ownership: Build, refine, and maintain market models and commercial data to serve as the foundation for commercial decision making. Set up automated data collection flows using AI for e.g. web scraping, desktop research, and external sources.

Strategic Partnership & Workshops: Act as a trusted partner to sales leaders and key stakeholders. Translate complex data into actionable sales leads, deliver clear insights, and facilitate interactive team workshops.

Technical Bridge & Systems: Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) to our Data Platform and Sales tech teams to ensure connections to our Salesforce, and Snowflake setups.

Visualization & Dashboards: Design and maintain intuitive dashboards and present insights for senior stakeholders to make intelligence accessible across the business.

What We Are Looking For
We value diverse backgrounds and fresh perspectives. While no candidate will check every single box, we are looking for someone who brings a strong combination of the following skills and qualities:

Background: A couple of years of experience in management consulting, scale-ups/startups, or an analytical commercial role.

Analytical Skills: Advanced capability in Excel/Google Sheets with an ability to identify clear signals within complex datasets.

Technical Toolbox: Experience with (or a strong desire to learn) SQL and Salesforce.

Curiosity for Innovation: Genuine interest in using AI tools and automation to optimize workflows and scale intelligence.

Project Leadership: Proven ability to take initiatives from early-stage ideas through to completed deliverables and implemented systems.

Mindset & Style: Adaptable, resourceful, and supportive. You are a strong communicator, a helpful teammate, and someone who thrives in a fast-changing environment.

Education & Languages: University degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field. Fluency in English is required; Swedish is a strong bonus.

Life at Instabee & What We Offer
We believe that high performance thrives in a supportive, flexible, and fun environment. Joining Instabee means joining a close-knit team that values every individual’s perspective.
Highlights of working with us:
🌇 Sky-High Office: Work from our modern, newly renovated Stockholm office with a 360-degree view of the city.
⏰ Flexibility: Hybrid setup and flexible working hours designed to support your life balance.
👶 Family-First Support: Paid parental leave top-up for six months so you can focus on your family when it matters most.
🎂 Birthday Off: Enjoy an extra paid day off each year to celebrate your birthday.
🐶 Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your furry friend to work—we have a dedicated dog-friendly floor!
🏓 Social & Fun: Ping pong, shuffleboard, foosball, and a dedicated karaoke room for team events and downtime.
Diversity & Inclusion
Instabee is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome applicants of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.
Ready to build the future of e-commerce with us? Apply today — we look forward to meeting you!
Our recruitment process 
To ensure a fair, objective, and safe process for everyone, our recruitment at Instabee includes two standard steps:
Assessment via Alva Labs: We believe in focusing on your potential rather than just a CV. As part of the application process, you’ll complete short, science-backed assessments (logic and personality) through Alva Labs. These help us understand your workplace strengths and ensure a data-driven, unbiased review.
Background Check: To maintain a secure environment for our team and customers, we perform background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys to review previous public criminal records. The results consist of public information and are always handled with strict confidentiality.
Both steps are a mandatory part of our hiring process in Sweden.

jobs.occupation: Electronics System Engineer to Beyond Gravity Gothenburg
jobs.description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​
 
About Beyond Gravity
Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com
 
Your crew

Join a highly collaborative, cross-functional team at the heart of Beyond Gravity’s Electronics business. Working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Programs, Production and other functions, you will contribute to the development of satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products as well as ground electronics products.
As an Electronics System Engineer, you will work at system and architectural level, providing system engineering expertise for electronics hardware systems, embedded processing systems and platform and payload solutions across development projects and series production programs in the satellite electronic solutions domain.
This is a role with significant development potential. You will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership, broaden your technical expertise and grow towards more advanced system engineering responsibilities over time.
 
Your mission

The Electronics System Engineer is responsible for:
Take ownership of your scope and bring assigned tasks to completion, involving more senior colleagues when needed.
Develop and maintain satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products as well as ground electronics products at system and architectural level.
Analyse and understand internal and external customer requirements and translate them into system-level requirements and technical solutions.
Break down system requirements into subsystem and module requirements and establish corresponding design requirements.
Develop technical concepts and system designs appropriate to customer and project needs, considering cost, time, quality, performance and technical feasibility.
Perform and/or assess system-level analyses, including performance, radiation, structural, EMC, reliability, FDIR and HW/FPGA/SW interaction analyses.
Coordinate development activities with other teams and disciplines to ensure complete and intended implementation of the system.
Plan and execute your own activities, monitor progress against schedule and budget, and raise awareness of risks and blocking points.
Support bidding and proposal activities through technical descriptions, concept work, cost and schedule estimates and risk and opportunity assessments.
Contribute to continuous improvement of products, technologies, processes and ways of working, challenging established solutions where appropriate.
Interact with customers, suppliers and external stakeholders within your area of responsibility and provide technical know-how to support successful project execution.
Maintain and develop system-level documentation and ensure compliance with established development processes and standards.

 
Most important outputs:
Robust and efficient system solutions that meet customer and project requirements.
Successful delivery of system engineering activities within agreed scope, quality, schedule and budget.
Continuous development of products, technologies and engineering methods.

 
Your story

We are looking for a technically curious and solution-oriented System Engineer with a strong interest in satellite electronics and system engineering. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable working independently and enjoy finding solutions to complex technical challenges.
You have a collaborative mindset and enjoy working across disciplines, with the ability to communicate clearly with colleagues, customers and external partners. You are motivated by continuous learning and want to develop your expertise and responsibility over time.
This role is a great opportunity for someone with strong potential to grow towards more advanced system engineering responsibilities and, in time, a Senior System Engineer role.
 
Must-haves:
M.Sc. in Electrical, Software or Aerospace Engineering, or corresponding experience.
Experience or good knowledge in system engineering, electronics or embedded systems, preferably within the space industry.
Understanding of requirements engineering, functional decomposition and system design.
Ability to perform or assess system-level analyses and understand HW/FPGA/SW interactions.
Ability to work independently, take ownership and deliver within agreed scope, schedule and budget.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.
Structured and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges and risk.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

 
Nice to have’s:
Experience with satellite onboard systems, platform and payload products or ground electronics.
Knowledge of FPGA, hardware, RF, signal processing or embedded systems.
Experience with tools such as MATLAB, DOORS, PSA, FMECA, DOSRAD or Reliability.
Knowledge of ECSS, agile methods or model-based systems engineering.
Experience with technical coordination, customer interaction or proposal work.
Knowledge of product roadmaps and current technology trends.

 
Why Beyond Gravity
 
To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!

 
🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​
Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​
​Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.occupation: UAS Flight Manager to UMS Skeldar in Linköping
jobs.description:
UMS SKELDAR is developing an unmanned helicopter to support naval, military and public safety operations. We have a fast and dynamic work environment with an entrepreneurial spirit. At UMS Skeldar, you get the unique chance to leave your footprint within our organization with fast reaction times and high engagement.

 Key words: Flight Manager, UAS Flight Manager, Unmanned Aircraft System, UAS Operations Manager, UAS Flight Operations Manager, Flight Operations Manager.
Join our Flight Operations team as a UAS Flight Manager and take a key role in leading and developing our growing flight organization. You will lead our flight operations, develop our flight crews and ways of working, and play an important part in shaping the future of unmanned aviation. We are looking for an experienced aviation or UAS professional who is ready to take the next step in their career and make a real impact in a dynamic and growing organization.UAS Flight Manager with us: 
As UAS Flight Manager, you will have overall responsibility for the safety and efficiency of our UAS flight operations. You will work closely with Remote Pilots, Flight Technicians, Engineering, Maintenance, Project Management, customers, and aviation authorities to ensure that our operations are planned and executed to the highest standards.
The role is both operational and strategic. You will be close to the daily flight operations while also developing our people, processes, and ways of working as our UAS operations continue to grow. You will report to the Head of Flight Operations.
As UAS Flight Manager, you will:

Lead and coordinate daily UAS flight operations, including planning, scheduling, execution, and post-flight activities, ensuring operations are conducted safely and in accordance with applicable regulations, authorizations, and company procedures.

Lead and develop our flight crews, including Remote Pilots, Flight Technicians, and Flight Test Engineers, with responsibility for training, proficiency, and competence management.

Drive safety and operational risk management, including safety reviews, risk assessments, audits, and continuous development of our Safety Management System (SMS).

Ensure operational readiness and compliance by working closely with Maintenance and reviewing flight-related procedures, documentation, records, and operational approvals.

Act as a key point of contact for operation sites, aviation authorities, customers, and internal stakeholders, supporting customer deliveries, demonstrations, new operational concepts, and other flight activities.

Drive continuous improvement across Flight Operations, identifying opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, processes, and operational performance.

Safety is at the heart of everything we do. As UAS Flight Manager, you will have the authority to suspend or cancel operations when safety or regulatory compliance is in question and to require additional training or proficiency measures when needed.
The workplace is dynamic, and the role may include both domestic and international travel depending on operational and organizational needs.
Does the position sound interesting? Do not hesitate to apply today!
Are you the one we are looking for? 
We place great emphasis on personal qualities so that you can thrive in the role. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is structured, safety-minded, and solution-oriented. You are confident in making well-considered decisions in a dynamic environment and know how to balance operational requirements with safety and regulatory compliance. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and build strong relationships with both operational teams and stakeholders across the organization. You are motivated by continuous improvement and have the drive to develop both yourself and the organization.
We believe you have at least five years of experience in flight operations management, aviation operations, or a comparable operational leadership role, with experience in UAS operations and/or commercial or military aviation. You have relevant education or professional training within aviation, aerospace, UAS, or military aviation, as well as a relevant UAS pilot license, certificate, or equivalent qualification. You have strong knowledge of aviation regulations and UAS operating requirements, combined with experience in operational risk management, safety processes, and a formal Safety Management System (SMS). You are experienced in leading, mentoring, and developing operational personnel and have a good understanding of flight planning, operational procedures, and aviation documentation. Excellent communication skills in English, both spoken and written, are essential.
Experience from multiple UAS platforms, complex operational authorizations, international operations, or military aviation is considered an advantage.
A B driver´s license is required.
We offer:
an opportunity to be part of a dynamic company that is constantly evolving, where your impact plays an important role

a high-tech product that is currently at the forefront of the market

a familiar work culture characterised by collaboration and high engagement

activities that promote both social community and health, through our Party Committee, Health Committee, Board Game Committee and a Women's Network.

More information:
Workplace: Linköping

Employment: Full-time

Start: Immediately with regard to notice period

Travel: Occurs in the service

For employment within UMS Skeldar, it is required that you will be approved in accordance with the Swedish Protective Security Act. For some roles with certain security-sensitive activities it may require certain citizenship.

På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av den natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.

Inspirationen hämtas från stadens tre kulturer den svenska, samiska och tornedalsfinska och genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Nu söker vi en engagerad och driven souschef som vill bli en viktig del av vårt kök och samtidigt njuta av en storslagen fjällvärld med norrsken, midnattssol och fantastiska fritidsmöjligheter.
Som souschef har du en central roll i den dagliga driften av köket och ansvarar för att servicen flyter på med hög kvalitet, struktur och ett gott samarbete mellan kök och servering. Du leder genom att vara en förebild, stöttar och motiverar dina kollegor och bidrar till en positiv, respektfull och lösningsorienterad arbetsmiljö.
I rollen ingår även att säkerställa kvalitet, struktur och hygien i köket samt planera mise en place, lager och beställningar. Tillsammans med kökschefen arbetar du med kostnader, matsvinn och menyutveckling. Du är en viktig länk mellan kök, kökschef och servering, löser problem som uppstår under service och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla både teamet och verksamheten.
Vi söker dig som har ett stort intresse för matlagning och yrket, trivs i ett högt tempo och tycker om att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Du har minst sex års erfarenhet inom restaurang, gärna med tre års utbildning och tre års arbetslivserfarenhet från à la carte-restaurang. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll, har god kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och/eller engelska och trivs med att ta ansvar. Som person är du engagerad, prestigelös och lösningsorienterad och motiveras av att skapa riktigt bra mat och få ett team att fungera tillsammans.
Tjänsten är på 100 % och är en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetstiderna varierar utifrån verksamhetens behov och innebär arbete på både vardagar och helger. Personalboende finns att tillgå vid behov.
Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten. Välkommen med din ansökan!
 
At Camp Ripan, you have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region so special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service and mutual respect are fundamental.
At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our restaurant, where we serve breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as larger events and gatherings. Our culinary inspiration comes from Kiruna’s three cultures Swedish, Sámi and Tornedalian which are reflected throughout our entire operation. Camp Ripan’s kitchen is one of Sweden’s most climate-conscious kitchens, where we use modern technology and sustainable practices to minimise our environmental impact.
We are now looking for an engaged and driven Sous Chef who wants to become an important part of our kitchen team while enjoying the spectacular mountain environment, with the Northern Lights, Midnight Sun and fantastic outdoor activities right on your doorstep.
As Sous Chef, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the kitchen and be responsible for ensuring that service runs smoothly, with high quality, structure and strong cooperation between the kitchen and other departments. You lead by example, support and motivate your colleagues, and contribute to a positive, respectful and solution-oriented working environment.
Your responsibilities will also include ensuring quality, structure and food safety in the kitchen, as well as planning mise en place, monitoring stock levels and handling orders. Together with the Head Chef, you will work with food and labour costs, food waste and menu development. You will be an important link between the kitchen, Head Chef and service, solving problems that arise during service and actively contributing to the development of both the team and the operation.
We are looking for someone with a genuine passion for cooking and the profession, who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working as part of a team. You have at least six years of experience in the restaurant industry, preferably including three years of culinary education and three years of professional experience in an à la carte restaurant. You are confident in your professional role, have good communication skills in Swedish and/or English, and enjoy taking responsibility. As a person, you are committed, humble and solution-oriented, with a genuine motivation to create great food and help a team perform at its best.
This is a full-time, permanent position (100%). Working hours vary according to the needs of the business and include both weekdays and weekends. Staff accommodation is available if needed.
Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once we have found the right candidate.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Bring the Future of Wind Propulsion Onboard

About Us
Wind helped us discover our planet, and now it can help us preserve it. Our vision is to provide wings for a shipping revolution, and we have two strong mother companies to back us up: Alfa Laval and Wallenius.
Would you like to contribute to this change, then join our fast-growing, highly competent and passionate team. AlfaWall Oceanbird AB is a 50/50 joint venture, owned by Alfa Laval and Wallenius but operated as an independent company. We are developing wing sail technology for the global shipping market and are now looking for an Installation Lead to join our team. Help us bring wind propulsion from shore to ship!
The role
As Oceanbird moves from a prototype stage into commercial customer delivery, successful installation is becoming one of our most important capabilities.
As Installation Lead, you will turn plans and technical solutions into safe, efficient and wellcoordinated installations at shipyards and onboard vessels. You will also be responsible for our demonstrator wing in Landskrona, coordinating its operation, maintenance and test readiness so that it provides the data needed for our continued development.

You will be part of the Project Management Office and work closely with our project managers. During installations, you will lead a cross-functional team of approximately 3–8 people, including electricians, service engineers, technical specialists and external contractors.
The Project Manager retains overall responsibility for the customer project, while you lead the dayto-day installation activities and safe execution at the shipyard, in harbor or at sea.

Your main responsibilities:
• Plan, prepare and lead installation and commissioning activities at shipyards/harbour and onboard vessels.
• Translate project and engineering requirements into practical installation plans, work sequences, resource needs and schedules.
• Coordinate the on-site installation team and act as Oceanbird’s operational interface with shipyards, vessel crews, customers and subcontractors.
• Lead the safe execution of installation work, ensuring that risk assessments, work permits, toolbox talks and agreed safety procedures are in place and followed.
• Monitor progress, quality and safety, resolve practical issues and escalate risks or decisions when required.
• Develop and maintain installation procedures, method statements, SOPs, checklists and installation manuals.
• Capture lessons learned and use them to improve future installations, documentation and ways of working.
• Coordinate the operation, maintenance, inspection and test readiness of the demonstrator wing and its supporting equipment in Landskrona.
• Plan activities together with the Landskrona team and work closely with our teams in Flemingsberg to incorporate experience from installations and testing into our continued development.

Who are you?
You are a practical and confident installation leader who can bring people from different disciplines together, create structure and maintain focus on safety and delivery—even when conditions change.
You are likely to have:
• Experience leading installations, commissioning, service or major maintenance involving complex mechanical or electromechanical equipment.

Classified by Alfa Laval as: Business
• Experience from commercial vessels and shipyards, ideally involving bulk carriers, tankers or similar vessel types.
• Experience from newbuild projects and working closely with shipyards in Asia is highly valuable.
• A relevant engineering qualification within mechanical, marine, electrical or a related technical field. This could be a vocational, college or bachelor-level qualification, or equivalent experience.
• A strong understanding of safe working practices in shipyard, industrial or onboard environments.
• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, contractors and external stakeholders.
• The ability to produce clear and practical technical documentation, including SOPs and installation manuals.
• Professional proficiency in English and the willingness to travel internationally and work onboard vessels.

You are safety-conscious, structured and calm under pressure. You communicate clearly across technical disciplines and cultures and are comfortable moving between planning, documentation and hands-on execution.

Location and travel
We are open to discussing the location for the right candidate, although proximity to either Flemingsberg or Landskrona is preferred.
Regular international travel and periods of work at shipyards and onboard vessels are an integral part of the role.

What we offer
At Oceanbird, you will help turn a bold vision into working technology at sea. You will see the direct result of your work as our wing sail technology moves from development and testing to installation onboard commercial vessels—and ultimately into operation at sea.
This is an opportunity to shape not only how our first commercial installations are delivered, but how Oceanbird will install wing sails around the world in the future. Working alongside highly skilled and passionate colleagues, you will influence our installation methods, safety standards and ways of working—and contribute directly to making wind a powerful part of cleaner shipping.

Join us in redefining the future of clean shipping.
Apply today and be part of a journey that truly makes a difference!

Verksamhetsbeskrivning
Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB är inte bara en arbetsplats, det är ett center för innovation och hantverksskicklighet inom bilindustrin. Beläget strax söder om Kristianstad, arbetar vi med en varierad kundbas som inkluderar försäkringsbolag, företag och privatpersoner. Would you like to play a key part in Toca Boca’s Data & Research engine? With over 60 million monthly active users and terabytes of daily data, as a Senior Data Scientist, you will play an integral role in understanding how kids and families engage with our play ecosystem, directly shaping fantastic, safe, and imaginative play experiences.

At Toca Boca, we don’t lock you into narrow corporate silos or endless maintenance tasks. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will enjoy broad end-to-end ownership across the entire product lifecycle—from exploratory data science, advanced modeling, and experimentation to product strategy and monetization dynamics.

You’ll join our Data & Analytics team while partnering seamlessly with our User Research team under a unified Insights banner. Together, we blend big data behavioral telemetry with qualitative player research, working closely with cross-functional game teams to unlock the full value of our play ecosystem.

What you’ll be doing

Uncover Deep Player Insights: Analyze complex player datasets to understand behavioral patterns, feature engagement, and retention drivers across our games, informing overall product and commerce strategy.
Apply Advanced Statistical Methods: Apply statistical models, regression analysis, predictive segmentation, and experimental methods (A/B testing) to optimize product performance at scale.
Bridge Quantitative & Qualitative Insights: Partner seamlessly with our User Research team under a unified Insights banner, connecting the "what" (big data trends) with the "why" (qualitative research) to deliver a 360-degree understanding of our players.
End-to-End Ownership & Influence: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous game product questions. Partner directly with PMs, Designers, and Engineers to translate complex datasets into clear, data-backed recommendations.

Broad Impact: You thrive with the freedom to influence multiple product areas—from core play loops and feature design to commerce and top-of-funnel engagement—without being pigeonholed.
Holistic Insights: You successfully bridge quantitative behavioral data with qualitative user research to create unified narratives that inspire game design.
Autonomy & Momentum: You help teams move quickly by surfacing key facts, reducing ambiguity, and solving open-ended problems that don't have predefined playbooks.

Is This You?

3+ years of experience (or equivalent senior-level impact) in user-focused Data Science or Advanced Product Analytics within Gaming, Mobile Apps, or Interactive Digital Products.
Empathy & Product Sense: Deep curiosity and intuition for player experience, engagement, and kids' digital environments.
SQL Mastery & Data Exploration: Outstanding SQL skills querying cloud data warehouses (experience with Google BigQuery and DBT is a huge plus).
Advanced DS Toolkit: Proficiency in Python (or R) for statistical modeling, machine learning, segmentation, and exploratory deep dives. Experience with BI tools like Tableau or Looker is a great plus!
Rigorous Statistical Foundation: Strong track record in experimentation lifecycle design, A/B test analysis, and hypothesis testing.
AI & Modern Workflows (Nice to have): Curiosity or Hands-on experience building, integrating, or utilizing AI/LLM tools within your data workflows or analytics stack.
Clear Storytelling & Autonomy: Skilled at translating complex quantitative and qualitative data into simple, compelling recommendations for non-technical partners. Thrives with high autonomy in fast-paced environments.

We celebrate the diversity and quirkiness of their world and give them the freedom to play in ways that only they can.

Good to know!

Our products focus on sparking kids’ creativity and imagination, creating opportunities for open-ended play.

With offices in Stockholm and San Francisco, Toca Boca is owned by Spin Master Corp., a global children’s entertainment company that creates, designs and manufactures a diversified portfolio of innovative toys, games, products and entertainment properties.

Are you a highly capable finance professional who wants to build and manage the financial backbone of a rapidly growing deep-tech and medical technology company?
Ascilion is now recruiting a Financial Controller to the company. The position is full-time and based at our headquarters in Kista.
At Ascilion we are singularly focused on solving one of medicine’s big challenges: providing real-time access to molecular biomarkers. Ascilion’s proprietary, industry-leading microneedle technology enables quick, reliable, and painless access to molecular biomarkers.
Ascilion is entering a phase of significant international growth with substantial investor involvement, increasing reporting requirements, expanding operations, and likely future subsidiaries and / or international sales entities. The Financial Controller is a key leadership position responsible for the overall financial management of the company, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of our financial reporting. Depending on profile and experience, the role may develop into a CFO position and become part of the senior management team with responsibility for strategic financial planning and board-level reporting. This is an excellent opportunity for you to join a dedicated and highly competent team and a growing company with an exciting journey ahead. If this sounds interesting to you, please contact us using the details below!
We will interview candidates continuously for the position and welcome your application today.
Responsibilities
As our Financial Controller, you will drive the company’s financial success by ensuring reporting accuracy, robust compliance, and strategic control over day-to-day financial operations. You will report directly to the CEO.
Your main responsibilities will be to:

Own and manage the company’s financial operations and reporting structure

Ensure high-quality financial reporting towards investors, board, auditors, and authorities

Prepare board material, financial presentations, forecasts, and KPI reporting

Coordinate and manage relationships with bookkeeping firms, auditors, banks, investors, and external financial partners

Develop and improve internal financial processes, controls, and reporting systems

Support international expansion including subsidiaries, sales offices, and cross-border financial structures

Drive budgeting, liquidity planning, cash flow management, and long-term financial planning

Ensure audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and professional financial governance

Support operational scaling of the company together with management and technical leadership

Potentially take responsibility for HR administration, contracts, insurance, and internal operational processes depending on profile and interest

Your Profile
Key qualifications for the position include:

Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or Economics.

Several years of experience in accounting, with a strong focus on financial reporting, accounting, controlling, and compliance

Experience working with investors, boards, auditors, and external financial stakeholders

Strong understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and corporate governance

A deep understanding of Swedish GAAP. Direct experience with US GAAP or IFRS is a competitive advantage

Experience from scaling companies, international operations, startups, medtech, deep-tech, or manufacturing environments is highly valuable

Experience with subsidiaries, international reporting structures, or US operations is a strong plus

Fluency in Swedish and English

We are looking for a structured, reliable, and highly detailed-oriented professional who enjoys taking ownership and creating order and clarity in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. As a person, you are analytical, strategic, pragmatic and execution-focused, with a strong ability to work with both details and the bigger picture. You have strong communication and collaboration skills, and you are comfortable operating close to both management and technical teams and presenting financial information clearly to both investors and engineers. Importantly, you thrive in an ambitious, high-performance environment and want to help build a globally significant company, not just manage spreadsheets
At Ascilion, you will have the opportunity to make an impact not only in your own area of responsibility, but also on the development of the company as a whole.
About Ascilion
Ascilion was founded in 2012 with a mission to solve the problem of sampling dermal interstitial fluid in an efficient and pain-free way. A team of engineers with deep experience in MEMS technology and microfluidics took on the challenge of solving what turned out to be a very complex problem.
We exist to bridge the worlds of precision engineering and biomarker science, creating innovative microneedle technologies that make dISF accessible, reliable, and painless; empowering researchers, clinicians, and companies to unlock the full potential of health monitoring and diagnostics.
We are currently in a very exciting expansion phase where we grow all aspects of the organization from R&D to sales. Our customer base is increasing with numerous close collaborations in Europe, the US, and Asia. Come, join our journey!

Do you enjoy creating clarity at the intersection of customers, Sales and Supply Chain? We’re looking for a Supply Chain Sales Support Manager to lead our global function and develop a proactive, structured and data-driven service that colleagues and customers can rely on.

Lead a global function at the heart of customer order flow. 
Shape how Sales and Supply Chain work together through clear governance, service levels, KPIs and digital tools.

jobs.description:
7Department of Forest Mycology and Plant Pathology
Join the Department of Forest Mycology and Plant Pathology at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) for a two-year postdoctoral position using population genomics to discover how rye adapts to different environments and what role its microbiota play. You will lead the genomic work in the Swedish Research Council-funded project ‘Eco-evolution of rye and its microbial allies’, and also carry out some field work and greenhouse studies.
About the position
Rye (Secale cereale L.) is cultivated where other cereals struggle, tolerating cold, drought and poor soils. Unlike its close relatives wheat and barley, rye is outcrossing, elabling it to maintain high genetic diversity. This makes rye a powerful system for understanding whether microbes help shape how plants adapt to their environment and how domestication has disrupted this. Landrace rye is also making a comeback on farms, so we can study living populations in the places that shaped them, rather than relying only on gene bank samples.
You will study rye populations ranging from wild and weedy relatives to landraces and inbred elite lines. Your main tasks will be to:
collect seeds from rye populations across northern Europe, grow them under standardised conditions in the greenhouse, and characterise their physiological and phenological traits and associated microbial communities
analyse whole-genome sequencing data to describe the genetic diversity and population structure of the rye populations
link genomic variation to plant traits, microbial communities and the environment to identify drivers of adaptation, for example through genome–environment association analyses and selection scans

You will work within the Soil Microbiology Group at the Department of Forest Mycology and Plant Pathology, whose focus is on understanding the role microorganisms play in biogeochemical processes. You will also be connected to a wider group of collaborators who support the genomic work, including evolutionary biologists at Uppsala University, Sweden, and crop genomic specialists at the University of Melbourne, Australia.
Your profile
We are looking for a person with a PhD in biology with a focus on population genetics, evolutionary biology, bioinformatics, ecology, agricultural science, or a related field, with documented capabilities of autonomous scientific research work and skills in writing scientific publications. The applicant should also be highly motivated, open-minded and team-oriented, and contribute positively to the development of the research environment.
Qualifications:
experience of analysing high-throughput sequencing data for population genomics, from raw reads to population-level analysis
experience of working from the command line on a computing cluster and of scripting, for example in bash, R or Pythongood

good written and spoken English, sufficient for scientific writing, reporting and participation in international project activities
It is an advantage if you have:
experience of whole-genome sequencing data, especially from large genomes
experience of associating genomic variation with traits or the environment
knowledge of evolutionary and eco-evolutionary processes in plants
experience of working with plants or microbial community data
a driver’s licence

We do not expect you to have all of these advantages. If your genomics experience comes from another study system, you are very welcome to apply, and we will support you in learning the plant and microbial work.
A position as a postdoctoral researcher is intended for a researcher early in their career. We are therefore primarily looking for candidates who completed their doctoral degree no more than three years before the application deadline. If your degree is older because of parental leave, illness, union duties, military service or similar circumstances, please state this in your application. If you are close to finishing your PhD, you are welcome to apply, provided your degree is awarded before the employment decision.
The assessment will also take into account personal qualities, such as your ability to collaborate, work independently and communicate clearly.
About us
The Department of Forest Mycology and Plant Pathology, SLU holds a top international position in research. We are dedicated to both fundamental and applied research, focusing on the vital interactions between plants, fungi, and other microorganisms in forest and agricultural systems. Our key research areas include Forest and Agricultural Plant Pathology, Plant-Soil-Microorganism Interactions, Microbial & Molecular Ecology, Comparative Genomics, and Biological Control. We tackle critical issues such as biodiversity loss, ecosystem function decline, and the impact of indigenous and invasive pests and diseases. Our work aims to develop sustainable agriculture and forestry practices, particularly in the face of climate change in order to minimize environmental impacts and economic losses.
For more information about the department or division visit: http://www.slu.se/mykopat
For more information about the project, see: https://www.slu.se/en/research/research-catalogue/projekt/e/eco-evolution-of-rye-and-its-microbial-allies/
Benefits include a salary supplement during parental leave, healthcare benefits and a wellness allowance. Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/
